[*GEBCO Compilation Group (2020) GEBCO 2020 Grid (doi:10.5285/a29c5465-b138-234d-e053-6c86abc040b9*)](https://www.gebco.net/data_and_products/gridded_bathymetry_data/)


```{python}
import xarray
import mikeio
```

```{python}
# | echo: false
# | output: false
xarray.set_options(display_expand_attrs=False, display_expand_coords=False)
```

```{python}
ds = xarray.open_dataset("../../data/gebco_2020_n56.3_s55.2_w12.2_e13.1.nc")
ds
```

```{python}
ds.elevation.plot();
```

```{python}
ds.elevation.sel(lon=12.74792, lat=55.865, method="nearest")
```

Check ordering of dimensions, should be (y,x)

```{python}
ds.elevation.dims
```

```{python}
el = ds.elevation.values
el.shape
```

Check that axes are increasing, S->N W->E

```{python}
ds.lat.values[0],ds.lat.values[-1] 
```

```{python}
ds.lat.values[0] < ds.lat.values[-1] 
```

```{python}
ds.lon.values[0],ds.lon.values[-1] 
```

```{python}
el[0,0] # Bottom left
```

```{python}
el[-1,0] # Top Left
```

```{python}
geometry = mikeio.Grid2D(x=ds.lon.values, y=ds.lat.values, projection="LONG/LAT")
geometry
```

```{python}
da = mikeio.DataArray(
    data=el,
    item=mikeio.ItemInfo("Elevation", mikeio.EUMType.Total_Water_Depth),
    geometry=geometry,
)
da
```

```{python}
da.plot();
```

```{python}
da.plot(cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-100, vmax=100);
```

```{python}
da.to_dfs("gebco.dfs2")
```

```{python}
ds = mikeio.read("gebco.dfs2")
ds.Elevation.plot()
```

## Setting the land value

To use the bathymetry as the domain of a MIKE 21 setup, the file needs a land value. It lives in the `M21_Misc` custom block, which is metadata for the whole file rather than for a single item, so it belongs on a `Dataset` — promote the `DataArray` with `to_dataset()` first.

```{python}
import numpy as np

ds = da.to_dataset()
ds.custom_blocks["M21_Misc"] = np.array(
    #  orient, drying, -900 = geographic, land value, unused...
    [0.0, 0.0, -900.0, 10.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
    dtype=np.float32,
)
ds.to_dfs("gebco.dfs2")
```

```{python}
mikeio.Dfs2("gebco.dfs2").custom_blocks
```

See [the Dfs2 user guide](../../user-guide/dfs2.qmd#custom-blocks) for the full layout of `M21_Misc`.
